profile.headline: Software Engineer | Wealthbox CRM ✨
profile.summary: Detail-oriented professional with an interest in and proven knowledge of advanced technology, programming languages, and creative processes.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Implement new features and enhancements using the Ruby programming language and Ruby on Rails framework.
- Implement user-facing functionality with Typescript and React. 
- Collaborate and pair program with other full-stack software engineers.
- Help with problem-solving and issue resolution, collaborating on bug fixes and improvements.

positions.title: Senior Customer Support Representative
positions.description:
- Respond via email and phone to customer questions, bug reports, etc.
- Process and document customer feature requests and bug reports.
- Demonstrate CRM features or troubleshoot customer issues via screensharing software.
- Manage the CRM knowledge base of FAQs, updating and creating new articles as needed.
- Handle billing inquiries & escalations.

positions.title: Framing Specialist
positions.description:
- Develop concepts or creative ideas for customly framed pictures or objects.
- Utilize specialized software in order to bring concepts to life.
- Confer with customers to access their wants/needs.

positions.title: Customer Service Agent
positions.description:
- Answer user inquiries regarding the CVS application or website to resolve issues.
- Develop new, SharePoint access to training materials and procedures and update information as-needed.
- Confer with customers by telephone to provide information about CVS products or services, take orders, and create or cancel accounts.
- Keep records of customer interactions, recording details of inquiries, complaints, or comments, as well as actions taken.
- Refer unresolved customer grievances to designated departments or supervisors as-needed.

positions.title: Kitchen Staff
positions.description:
- Ensure freshness of food and ingredients by checking for quality, keeping track of old and new items, and rotating stock.
- Season and cook food according to recipes, personal judgement, and experience.
- Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients using various kitchen utensils and equipment.
- Portion, arrange, and garnish food, and serve food to waitstaff.
- Substitute for or assist other cooks during emergencies or rush periods.

positions.title: Graphic Artist
positions.description:
- Check preliminary and final proofs for glaring errors and instruct for corrections.
- Operate desktop publishing software and equipment to design, layout, and produce finished product.
- Convert various types of files for printing using InDesign and Acrobat.
- Enter digitized data into the prepress system using scanners, cameras, keyboard, and mouse.

positions.title: Nuclear IT Intern
positions.description:
- Modify existing databases and database management systems in order to ensure efficient schema.
- Write and code logical and physical database descriptions and specify identifiers of database management system.
- Write, design, and edit web page content.
- Confer with management or development teams to prioritize needs, resolve conflicts, develop content criteria, and choose solutions.
- Analyze user needs to determine technical requirements.

positions.title: Cashier Customer Service
positions.description: Simple job cashing out customers, tending to customer’s needs, and occasionally stocking or rearranging products on shelves.
